summary.key_distinction: GBP, JPY, CAD and AUD are DAILY_READY: canonical official-source collectors, candidate builders and currency-only deterministic dry-run apply paths are on main and were certified from clean main-based release candidates. DAILY_READY never means automatic publication; live runtime promotion remains gated and explicit.

AUD.source: ASX 30 Day Interbank Cash Rate futures (IB)
AUD.methodology: Direct official ASX SFN settlement prices transformed as 100 minus settlement; canonical Dec-26/Mar-27/Sep-27 buckets; no interpolation.
AUD.weekly_reference_rule: Use the fifth prior complete official ASX SFN trading session (T-5); no calendar approximation.
AUD.legacy_runtime_note: The currently published 2026-09-30 runtime still carries the earlier 24-Sep approximate weekly comparison (-6/-7/-11 bp). DAILY_READY certification adopts exact official T-5 (23-Sep: -4/-3/-2.5 bp) for future refreshes. Published runtime is not changed by this readiness promotion.
